# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie Tulk is described as heavy-set, to the extent that Nell considers her too heavy to play a fairy queen. She wears dresses with flounces and prides herself on her attire.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, caustic-tongued, and prone to gloating. She frequently cheats or breaks rules to get ahead in school, mocks others' appearances or failures, and harbors intense jealousy, particularly toward Nell Harcourt. She is also confident in her physical balance and boasts of her family's wealth.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Goals

- To excel in school and surpass her rivals  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## History

Flossie is a student at Brierley School who frequently competes with her peers and cheats during lessons. She mocks Nell Harcourt when Nell is punished for breaking her slate over Hugh Carrow's head, and later dares Nell to walk a roof ridgepole, resulting in Nell falling and spraining her ankle. Flossie later qualifies for the Regent's entrance class and attends Regent's Academy in Port Marlow alongside Nell and Hugh. After passing her Entrance exams, she decides to continue her education at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c32 P39](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0039)_
